description.value: Pizzability is a 100% Vancouver Island-owned independent pizzeria making dough in-house daily and using handmade sauces and premium fresh toppings. The Langford location sits beside Bucky's Taphouse at the Glen Lake Inn on Sooke Road, serving the Westshore corridor. The menu spans classic and gourmet pizzas, pastas, wings, garlic ribs, and sides available for pickup or local delivery.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and confirms the Langford location at 2668 Sooke Road with phone 778.433.6888, matching OSM tags. The order page explicitly offers pickup as well as delivery, and the pizza menu lists a dedicated Vegetarian pizza option. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site. OSM names this location 'Pizzability Glenlake' but the website consistently calls it 'Pizzability Langford'; the 'Glen Lake' reference on the website (it sits at the Glen Lake Inn) explains the OSM naming choice.
concerns: OSM name is 'Pizzability Glenlake' but the website consistently uses 'Pizzability Langford' for this location. The 'Glenlake' tag likely derives from the nearby Glen Lake Inn reference on the website, not an official location name used by the business.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly accessible pizza restaurant with confirmed website, phone, and address. Useful stop for touring cyclists on the Sooke Road / Westshore corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Pizza menu includes a named 'Vegetarian' specialty pizza (mushroom, tomatoes, green peppers, black olives, onions, pineapple). No vegan or GF options mentioned

wow_evidence: 100% Vancouver Island-owned independent pizzeria making dough in-house daily
